skill.name: ux-researcher-designer
skill.description: UX research and design toolkit for persona generation, journey mapping, usability testing, research synthesis, and design validation.
skill.summary: Create research-backed personas and UX design artifacts from structured user insights.
skill.author: alirezarezvani

security_audit.summary: The only static finding is a false positive caused by inline Markdown command usage in SKILL.md. No evidence found for prompt injection, data exfiltration, or unauthorized network, filesystem, or environment access.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 22 is Markdown documentation showing how to run the local persona generator, not Ruby or shell backtick execution. The command is not executed by the skill instructions.

content.user_title: Create UX Research Personas and Maps
content.value_statement: UX teams need structured research outputs that connect evidence to design decisions. This skill turns user data and interview insights into personas, journeys, test plans, and validation guidance.
actual_capabilities: Generate research-backed personas from structured user records and interview insights.
Identify persona archetypes, goals, frustrations, behaviors, and design implications.
Provide sample personas with confidence levels based on input sample size.
Support journey mapping, usability testing frameworks, and research synthesis workflows.
Format persona findings for stakeholder review and design planning.
limitations: Persona generation depends on the quality and representativeness of supplied research data.
The included script uses heuristic archetypes, not statistical clustering or machine learning.
It does not collect research participants or run live usability tests.
Generated recommendations still need review by qualified UX researchers.

use_cases.title: Build Product Personas
use_cases.description: Turn survey records and interview notes into concise personas for roadmap and feature discussions.

use_cases.title: Prepare Research Synthesis
use_cases.description: Summarize recurring behaviors, motivations, pain points, and design implications after user interviews.

use_cases.title: Validate Design Direction
use_cases.description: Use personas, journey steps, and usability criteria to check whether a design supports priority users.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Persona
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner persona creation from a short research summary.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create one UX persona from these user notes. Include goals, frustrations, behaviors, needs, and design implications.

prompt_templates.title: Map a Customer Journey
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate journey mapping for a known persona.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a customer journey map for this persona and task. Include stages, user actions, emotions, pain points, and opportunities.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Usability Test
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning for a moderated or unmoderated test.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a usability test plan for this flow. Include research questions, participant criteria, tasks, metrics, risks, and synthesis steps.

prompt_templates.title: Synthesize Mixed Research
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced synthesis across quantitative and qualitative evidence.
prompt_templates.prompt: Synthesize these analytics, survey results, and interview notes. Identify patterns, confidence level, persona impact, and design recommendations.

output_examples.input: Survey responses from 30 users, plus three interview quotes about dashboard use.
output_examples.output: A persona with archetype, demographics, goals, frustrations, behaviors, representative quote, confidence level, and design implications.

output_examples.input: A checkout flow and notes from five failed usability sessions.
output_examples.output: A usability synthesis with task breakdown, friction points, severity labels, evidence summary, and prioritized design fixes.

output_examples.input: A mobile-first persona and a task to share a project with a teammate.
output_examples.output: A journey map covering stages, actions, emotions, pain points, and opportunities for mobile collaboration improvements.

best_practices: Provide raw research notes, sample size, participant context, and known bias risks.
Ask for confidence levels and evidence links when using outputs for product decisions.
Review generated personas with researchers, designers, and stakeholders before adoption.
anti_patterns: Do not treat generated personas as validated research without supporting participant evidence.
Do not use tiny or biased samples to justify broad product strategy changes.
Do not remove contradictory findings only to make a cleaner research story.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create personas, journey maps, usability test plans, research synthesis, and design validation guidance.

faq.question: Can it use real user research?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide structured user data, interview notes, survey findings, or analytics summaries for better outputs.

faq.question: Does it replace a UX researcher?
faq.answer: No. It supports research synthesis and artifact creation, but human review remains required.

faq.question: What tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it run network calls?
faq.answer: No evidence found for network access in the reviewed files.

faq.question: What input works best?
faq.answer: Use clear research notes with participant context, behaviors, goals, pain points, and sample size.
